NASB.1: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
NASB.2: 'Command the sons of Israel and say to them, 'When you enter the land of Canaan, this is the land that shall fall to you as an inheritance, [even the] land of Canaan according to its borders.
NASB.3: 'Your southern sector shall extend from the wilderness of Zin along the side of Edom, and your southern border shall extend from the end of the Salt Sea eastward.
NASB.4: 'Then your border shall turn [direction] from the south to the ascent of Akrabbim and continue to Zin, and its termination shall be to the south of Kadesh-barnea; and it shall reach Hazaraddar and continue to Azmon.
NASB.5: 'The border shall turn [direction] from Azmon to the brook of Egypt, and its termination shall be at the sea.
NASB.6: 'As for the western border, you shall have the Great Sea, that is, [its] coastline; this shall be your west border.
NASB.7: 'And this shall be your north border: you shall draw your [border] line from the Great Sea to Mount Hor.
NASB.8: 'You shall draw a line from Mount Hor to the Lebo-hamath, and the termination of the border shall be at Zedad;
NASB.9: and the border shall proceed to Ziphron, and its termination shall be at Hazar-enan. This shall be your north border.
NASB.10: 'For your eastern border you shall also draw a line from Hazar-enan to Shepham,
NASB.11: and the border shall go down from Shepham to Riblah on the east side of Ain; and the border shall go down and reach to the slope on the east side of the Sea of Chinnereth.
NASB.12: 'And the border shall go down to the Jordan and its termination shall be at the Salt Sea. This shall be your land according to its borders all around.''
NASB.13: So Moses commanded the sons of Israel, saying, 'This is the land that you are to apportion by lot among you as a possession, which the LORD has commanded to give to the nine and a half tribes.
NASB.14: 'For the tribe of the sons of Reuben have received [theirs] according to their fathers' households, and the tribe of the sons of Gad according to their fathers' households, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their possession.
NASB.15: 'The two and a half tribes have received their possession across the Jordan opposite Jericho, eastward toward the sunrising.'
NASB.16: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
NASB.17: 'These are the names of the men who shall apportion the land to you for inheritance: Eleazar the priest and Joshua the son of Nun.
NASB.18: 'You shall take one leader of every tribe to apportion the land for inheritance.
NASB.19: 'These are the names of the men: of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
NASB.20: 'Of the tribe of the sons of Simeon, Samuel the son of Ammihud.
NASB.21: 'Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.
NASB.22: 'Of the tribe of the sons of Dan a leader, Bukki the son of Jogli.
NASB.23: 'Of the sons of Joseph: of the tribe of the sons of Manasseh a leader, Hanniel the son of Ephod.
NASB.24: 'Of the tribe of the sons of Ephraim a leader, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.
NASB.25: 'Of the tribe of the sons of Zebulun a leader, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.
NASB.26: 'Of the tribe of the sons of Issachar a leader, Paltiel the son of Azzan.
NASB.27: 'Of the tribe of the sons of Asher a leader, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.
NASB.28: 'Of the tribe of the sons of Naphtali a leader, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.'
NASB.29: These are those whom the LORD commanded to apportion the inheritance to the sons of Israel in the land of Canaan.

ESV.1: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
ESV.2: “Command the people of Israel, and say to them, When you enter the land of Canaan (this is the land that shall fall to you for an inheritance, the land of Canaan as defined by its borders),
ESV.3: your south side shall be from the wilderness of Zin alongside Edom, and your southern border shall run from the end of the Salt Sea on the east.
ESV.4: And your border shall turn south of the ascent of Akrabbim, and cross to Zin, and its limit shall be south of Kadesh-barnea. Then it shall go on to Hazar-addar, and pass along to Azmon.
ESV.5: And the border shall turn from Azmon to the Brook of Egypt, and its limit shall be at the sea.
ESV.6: “For the western border, you shall have the Great Sea and its  coast. This shall be your western border.
ESV.7: “This shall be your northern border: from the Great Sea you shall draw a line to Mount Hor.
ESV.8: From Mount Hor you shall draw a line to Lebo-hamath, and the limit of the border shall be at Zedad.
ESV.9: Then the border shall extend to Ziphron, and its limit shall be at Hazar-enan. This shall be your northern border.
ESV.10: “You shall draw a line for your eastern border from Hazar-enan to Shepham.
ESV.11: And the border shall go down from Shepham to Riblah on the east side of Ain. And the border shall go down and reach to the shoulder of the Sea of Chinnereth on the east.
ESV.12: And the border shall go down to the Jordan, and its limit shall be at the Salt Sea. This shall be your land as defined by its borders all around.”
ESV.13: Moses commanded the people of Israel, saying, “This is the land that you shall inherit by lot, which the LORD has commanded to give to the nine tribes and to the half-tribe.
ESV.14: For the tribe of the people of Reuben by fathers' houses and the tribe of the people of Gad by their fathers' houses have received their inheritance, and also the half-tribe of Manasseh.
ESV.15: The two tribes and the half-tribe have received their inheritance beyond the Jordan east of Jericho, toward the sunrise.”
ESV.16: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
ESV.17: “These are the names of the men who shall divide the land to you for inheritance: Eleazar the priest and Joshua the son of Nun.
ESV.18: You shall take one chief from every tribe to divide the land for inheritance.
ESV.19: These are the names of the men: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
ESV.20: Of the tribe of the people of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.
ESV.21: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.
ESV.22: Of the tribe of the people of Dan a chief, Bukki the son of Jogli.
ESV.23: Of the people of Joseph: of the tribe of the people of Manasseh a chief, Hanniel the son of Ephod.
ESV.24: And of the tribe of the people of Ephraim a chief, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.
ESV.25: Of the tribe of the people of Zebulun a chief, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.
ESV.26: Of the tribe of the people of Issachar a chief, Paltiel the son of Azzan.
ESV.27: And of the tribe of the people of Asher a chief, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.
ESV.28: Of the tribe of the people of Naphtali a chief, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.”
ESV.29: These are the men whom the LORD commanded to divide the inheritance for the people of Israel in the land of Canaan.

AMP.1: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
AMP.2: "Command the Israelites, 'When you enter the land of Canaan, this is the land that shall be yours as an inheritance, the land of Canaan according to its boundaries,
AMP.3: your southern region shall be from the Wilderness of Zin along the side of Edom, and your southern boundary from the end of the Salt (Dead) Sea eastward.
AMP.4: Your boundary shall turn from the south to the ascent of Akrabbim, and continue on to Zin, and its limit shall be south of Kadesh-barnea. Then it shall go on to Hazar-addar and pass on to Azmon.
AMP.5: Then the boundary shall turn from Azmon to the Brook of Egypt (Wadi el-arish), and its limit shall be at the [Mediterranean] Sea.
AMP.6: 'As the western boundary you shall have the Great [Mediterranean] Sea and its coastline. This shall be your western boundary.
AMP.7: 'And this shall be your north border: from the Great [Mediterranean] Sea mark out your boundary line to Mount Hor;
AMP.8: from Mount Hor you shall mark out your boundary to the entrance of Hamath, and the limit of the border shall be at Zedad;
AMP.9: then the [northern] boundary shall go on to Ziphron, and its limit shall be at Hazar-enan. This shall be your northern boundary.
AMP.10: 'You shall mark out your eastern boundary from Hazar-enan to Shepham;
AMP.11: the [eastern] boundary shall go down from Shepham to Riblah on the east side of Ain and shall descend and reach to the slope on the east of the Sea of Chinnereth [the Sea of Galilee];
AMP.12: and the [eastern] boundary shall go down to the Jordan [River], and its limit shall be at the Salt (Dead) Sea. This shall be your land according to its boundaries all around.'"
AMP.13: So Moses commanded the Israelites, saying, "This is the land you are to inherit by lot, which the LORD has commanded to be given to the nine tribes and the half-tribe [of Manasseh],
AMP.14: for the tribe of the sons of Reuben and the tribe of the sons of Gad have received their inheritance by their fathers' households, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their possession.
AMP.15: The two and a half tribes have received their inheritance across the Jordan [River] opposite Jericho, eastward toward the sunrise."
AMP.16: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
AMP.17: "These are the names of the men who shall divide the land among you as an inheritance: Eleazar the priest and Joshua the son of Nun.
AMP.18: You shall take one leader from every tribe to divide the land for the inheritance.
AMP.19: These are the names of the men: From the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh;
AMP.20: from the tribe of the sons of Simeon, Samuel the son of Ammihud;
AMP.21: from the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon;
AMP.22: from the tribe of the sons of Dan a leader, Bukki the son of Jogli;
AMP.23: of the sons of Joseph: from the tribe of the sons of Manasseh a leader, Hanniel the son of Ephod;
AMP.24: from the tribe of the sons of Ephraim a leader, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan;
AMP.25: from the tribe of the sons of Zebulun a leader, Elizaphan the son of Parnach;
AMP.26: from the tribe of the sons of Issachar a leader, Paltiel the son of Azzan;
AMP.27: from the tribe of the sons of Asher a leader, Ahihud the son of Shelomi;
AMP.28: from the tribe of the sons of Naphtali a leader, Pedahel the son of Ammihud."
AMP.29: These are the [twelve] men whom the LORD commanded [to work with Joshua and Eleazar] to divide the inheritance to the sons of Israel in the land of Canaan.

NLT.1: Then the LORD said to Moses,
NLT.2: “Give these instructions to the Israelites: When you come into the land of Canaan, which I am giving you as your special possession, these will be the boundaries.
NLT.3: The southern portion of your country will extend from the wilderness of Zin, along the edge of Edom. The southern boundary will begin on the east at the Dead Sea.
NLT.4: It will then run south past Scorpion Pass in the direction of Zin. Its southernmost point will be Kadesh-barnea, from which it will go to Hazar-addar, and on to Azmon.
NLT.5: From Azmon the boundary will turn toward the Brook of Egypt and end at the Mediterranean Sea.
NLT.6: “Your western boundary will be the coastline of the Mediterranean Sea.
NLT.7: “Your northern boundary will begin at the Mediterranean Sea and run east to Mount Hor,
NLT.8: then to Lebo-hamath, and on through Zedad
NLT.9: and Ziphron to Hazar-enan. This will be your northern boundary.
NLT.10: “The eastern boundary will start at Hazar-enan and run south to Shepham,
NLT.11: then down to Riblah on the east side of Ain. From there the boundary will run down along the eastern edge of the Sea of Galilee,
NLT.12: and then along the Jordan River to the Dead Sea. These are the boundaries of your land.”
NLT.13: Then Moses told the Israelites, “This territory is the homeland you are to divide among yourselves by sacred lot. The LORD has commanded that the land be divided among the nine and a half remaining tribes.
NLT.14: The families of the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh have already received their grants of land
NLT.15: on the east side of the Jordan River, across from Jericho toward the sunrise.”
NLT.16: And the LORD said to Moses,
NLT.17: “Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun are the men designated to divide the grants of land among the people.
NLT.18: Enlist one leader from each tribe to help them with the task.
NLT.19:
These are the tribes and the names of the leaders: Tribe — Leader
Judah — Caleb son of Jephunneh
NLT.23: Manasseh son of Joseph — Hanniel son of Ephod
NLT.24: Ephraim son of Joseph — Kemuel son of Shiphtan
NLT.29: These are the men the LORD has appointed to divide the grants of land in Canaan among the Israelites.”

NRSVCE.1: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying:
NRSVCE.2: Command the Israelites, and say to them: When you enter the land of Canaan (this is the land that shall fall to you for an inheritance, the land of Canaan, defined by its boundaries),
NRSVCE.3: your south sector shall extend from the wilderness of Zin along the side of Edom. Your southern boundary shall begin from the end of the Dead Sea on the east;
NRSVCE.4: your boundary shall turn south of the ascent of Akrabbim, and cross to Zin, and its outer limit shall be south of Kadesh-barnea; then it shall go on to Hazar-addar, and cross to Azmon;
NRSVCE.5: the boundary shall turn from Azmon to the Wadi of Egypt, and its termination shall be at the Sea.
NRSVCE.6: For the western boundary, you shall have the Great Sea and its coast; this shall be your western boundary.
NRSVCE.7: This shall be your northern boundary: from the Great Sea you shall mark out your line to Mount Hor;
NRSVCE.8: from Mount Hor you shall mark it out to Lebo-hamath, and the outer limit of the boundary shall be at Zedad;
NRSVCE.9: then the boundary shall extend to Ziphron, and its end shall be at Hazar-enan; this shall be your northern boundary.
NRSVCE.10: You shall mark out your eastern boundary from Hazar-enan to Shepham;
NRSVCE.11: and the boundary shall continue down from Shepham to Riblah on the east side of Ain; and the boundary shall go down, and reach the eastern slope of the sea of Chinnereth;
NRSVCE.12: and the boundary shall go down to the Jordan, and its end shall be at the Dead Sea. This shall be your land with its boundaries all around.
NRSVCE.13: Moses commanded the Israelites, saying: This is the land that you shall inherit by lot, which the LORD has commanded to give to the nine tribes and to the half-tribe;
NRSVCE.14: for the tribe of the Reubenites by their ancestral houses and the tribe of the Gadites by their ancestral houses have taken their inheritance, and also the half-tribe of Manasseh;
NRSVCE.15: the two tribes and the half-tribe have taken their inheritance beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, toward the sunrise.
